facts_carried_over: NECC appointed Joanne Landers as Vice President of Student Affairs, effective July 1, 2025; NECC News, 2025-05-14.
NECC reported 5,307 credit students in Fall 2025, including 81.1% part-time and 49.2% Hispanic or Latino; NECC Quick Facts, Fall 2025 page retrieved 2026-09-15.

NECC leadership lists Joanne Landers as Vice President of Enrollment Management & Student Affairs, Danny Rivera as Chief Technology Officer, Michael McCarthy as Executive Vice President and CFO/COO, Austin Gilliland as Vice President of Academic Affairs, and Lane Glenn as President; NECC Leadership Cabinet, retrieved 2026-09-15.

NECC publicly documents Brightspace as its LMS, Navigate for advising and student support, DegreeWorks, Self-service, and Banner infrastructure; NECC technology and student pages, retrieved 2026-09-15.
NECC's October 2025 trustee update reported enrollment above 5,000 for the first time since 2018 and said growth required additional student support; NECC Board of Trustees Update, 2025-10-01.
